# Belize Kids Web App (Vite + React)

## Project
Belize Kids website built with Vite, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui.

## Repo Layout
- src/pages: route-level pages (React Router).
- src/components: reusable sections and feature components.
- src/components/ui: shadcn/ui components.
- src/index.css: Tailwind base + theme variables.
- src/lib/utils.ts: shared helpers (e.g., `cn`).

## Running
- npm install
- npm run dev

## Conventions
- Use `@` alias for `src` (see `vite.config.ts`).
- Prefer shadcn/ui components from `src/components/ui`.
- Use button/badge variants defined in `src/components/ui/button.tsx` and `src/components/ui/badge.tsx` for Belize brand colors.
- Keep styling in Tailwind; avoid adding new global CSS unless necessary.

## Routing
Routes are defined in `src/App.tsx`:
- `/`, `/projects`, `/projects/:slug`, `/leadership`, `/doctors`, `/monthly-investment`,
  `/privacy`, `/terms`, `/sitemap.xml`.

## Theme
Brand palette is defined in `tailwind.config.ts` under `colors.belize`, with CSS variables in `src/index.css`.
